title: Accessibility, demonstrated
intro: WCAG 2.1 AA is built-in, not audited later — shipped on healthcare platforms (see Impact). Here: semantic landmarks, ordered headings, visible focus rings, 44px touch targets, full keyboard navigation, and user preference controls.

practices.title: Semantic HTML
practices.body: Landmarks, lists and native controls before ARIA.

practices.title: Visible focus
practices.body: Focus ring on every interactive element.

practices.title: Screen readers
practices.body: Meaningful names, live status regions, labelled icons.

practices.title: axe DevTools
practices.body: Automated checks alongside manual keyboard and reader passes.

practices.title: Colour contrast
practices.body: AA contrast plus an optional high-contrast mode.

practices.title: Focus management
practices.body: Dialogs trap focus and return it on close.

tryItBody: Press Tab to walk the page — every control shows a focus ring. Esc closes any open dialog or panel, and focus returns to where you left it.
readAloudNote: Read-aloud uses your browser's speech voice, never autoplays, and has play, pause and stop controls. Every spoken passage is also on the page as text.
